title: Prune retired zero-only constructor profiler metrics
question: After GPU-12 fused away the generic any/generator structural scans and GPU-16 narrowed profiling to constructor-native attribution, should their permanently zero profiler metrics and helper machinery remain on the active diagnostic surface?

baseline_evidence.observation: Across all six frozen Boolean profile cases, constructor_validation_generators.calls and builtin_any.calls were both zero after the GPU-12 fused validation change.
baseline_evidence.claim: historical attribution only; not a performance comparison

change.schema: Bump daedalus-tensor-typed-block-validation-profile/4 to /5 because two retired metrics are intentionally removed from the report contract.
change.remove_retired_metrics: Delete constructor_validation_generators and builtin_any from the active metric surface after frozen evidence shows both remain zero across the complete bounded case matrix.
change.remove_dead_helpers: Delete _nested_codes, _builtin_metrics, and the now-unused CodeType import instead of retaining machinery for metrics that no longer identify an active cost.
change.retain_active_attribution: Keep bitset factory, canonical TypedRelationBlock.__post_init__, constructor-native _stored, bounded sequence admission, semiring resolution, and identifier admission attribution.
change.regression: Pin schema /5, the six active metrics, absence of the retired helpers and prior standalone scalar timer, support/digest parity, bounds, and constructor-native call counts.

finding.summary: The two profiler metrics introduced to diagnose GPU-11-era generic validation scans have completed their purpose. Post-GPU-12 frozen evidence keeps both at zero across the bounded matrix, so retaining their recursive code-discovery and builtin-string matching adds diagnostic bloat without explaining an active cost.
finding.negative_result: This packet deliberately makes no production constructor optimization and provides no new speedup number. Removing zero-only metrics does not justify a trusted constructor, alternate relation type, cache, backend, or validation bypass.
finding.next_implication: Further Tensor work should use the smaller /5 active profile to isolate one concrete in-path constructor cost before changing production relation materialization.
